description: Desktop app to run and control coding agents across local machines and servers
notes: enowX keeps its app state in %USERPROFILE%\.enowx-app (projects.json, notes, vault, settings, and a daemon copy in daemon\). This manifest redirects it into the Scoop persist folder; to reuse an existing installation's state, copy that folder into the persist folder before uninstalling the old copy.
This package uses the portable tarball from GitHub Releases. The upstream Setup .exe is an NSIS installer and is not used.
The enowx-app command line tool is created by the app itself (Settings -> App -> Command line) and is not shipped as a separate executable in this archive.
